messages.content_text:
june 5 Notes:


I went breakeven again today and at this point it is getting pretty crazy, I think I have some ideas of how to hopefully resolve the issue going into next week.
,
The trade I took was in london and we had made relative equal lows with london lows and at this point I was already bearish because we were down a lot of points and my draw was the previous week nwog and relative equal lows. we made the equal lows and then traded back up into the range and I noticed that 00:00 was in the ote and had el right below it and it also aligned with a 5 and 15min gap. I place my limit at 00:00 and price tapped it and gave a 0dd entry, reacted 40 points befor stopping me out at breakeven. I had a 20pt stop and 100pt tp so this was pretty disappointing. I think it was a good trade and I could see it playing out. It is a little shocking to get breakeven, but no worries. (Screenshot 1 & 2)
,
New york session was interesting because we dropped a lot of points, but we never really got a setup that I would be interested in. We took out all of my draws on liquidity though. I also made some great calls to determine my bias for this week which turned out to be right. Firstly, I noted that there weren’t any nearby unmitigated htf confluences to retrace into, so a bearish move right now may be bigger. I was also looking at my stock portfolio on monday and was up quite a significant amount for a single day. I was happy about it and at that point realized it was probably going to be a fake move up to generate optimism and take advantage of greed in a bull market, further strengthening my bearish bias for the week.
,

Must Journal every day with trade and psychology before and after trade.

DAY 11  : 1 TRADE 1 L

TECHNICAL ANALYSIS
Bias was bearish for once. MMSM was being acted on. Knew that price wanted to reach NDOG. ES already did so that gave me a strong confluence that we were going to go lower. So we swept an ASIA low, but left relative equal lows which left me more sure that i wanted to short. Waited for a retracement to discount of the range, it tapped EQ and reacted off of a 15 min FVG (highest TF of confluence), and delivered down. I looked for a 1 min breaker within the range, which i saw a doji candle breaker, which made me question the validity of the breaker. The breaker was already mitigated so it was already lower probability that a retap would play out. it stopped me out and instead reached for the 1 min OB instead. seeing that the leg still reacted off of the 15 min FVG again, i looked within the 15 sec off of the 1 min OB to find a breaker leg. Found one, but was a few seconds too late to place the trade. There was a bit of hesitation involved too. But the trade fully played out and went to full TP. To me foundationally, that trade was an at least A setup.

Psychological Analysis
Wasn't rushing to find a trade, though with the first trade i felt a bit of 'ah shit i missed it, maybe it'll retrace and retap'. which sure it could've but logically a retap wouldn't be ideal when the BB is mitigated already. So perhaps there was the slightest bit of FOMO there, which probably also got me to miss some potential future candidates. Also i wasn't fully sure if this trade would play out, so ideally waiting for an entry trigger would be the best course of action. It was a bit of gambling there. Cause the account was already good as dead, and i wasn't trying to preserve it, so i kind of risked a play here. Which really isn't great. I shouldn't be putting money on low probability trades no matter how little the risk is, it'll start to create a bad habit of gambling. Second trade was missed perhaps because of hesistation but also not realizing it was a good trade. I did try to hold a limit there in case it came back, but it ran and even tried to see if it would properly retrace all the way, it didn't and that probably woudln't have been the best risk to take. That could be a form of fomo as well.
